title: privacy-notice-eu native sidecar 1.0
description: Machine-readable summary of a single drafted privacy notice, lifted from the delivery-summary Assumptions/Contested-flags block the skill already produces in prose (SKILL.md 'Confidence and what gets handed back'). Structural tier: this schema plus the validator's completeness/consistency rules is the whole of this skill's portfolio-standard adoption — there is no findings-based legal rule engine.

notice_type.description: The five notice types SKILL.md Step 1 offers, plus 'combined'.

controller_name.description: The controller this notice is drafted for. Used to derive the core-artefact subject.id/label.

jurisdictions.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the target markets, matching the reference file(s) loaded per SKILL.md Step 1 (DE, FR, AT, IT, ES, NL, BE, IE, UK).

localizes_users.description: Whether the service can reliably localise which market a given user is in. Drives which children's-age-threshold rule applies (EU_COMMON.md 'Multi-jurisdiction rule').

art13_14_compliant.description: The notice's own claim that Art. 13/14 mandatory disclosures (EU_COMMON.md checklist) are all present or explicitly not applicable.

settled_count.description: Count of non-trivial legal positions tagged Settled (SKILL.md 'Confidence and what gets handed back').

assumed.description: Positions rendered but resting on an unverified intake answer or unconfirmed default — the delivery summary's Assumptions block.

confirm_with_counsel_flag_emitted.description: Whether a visible [TO CONFIRM WITH COUNSEL: ...] flag was actually rendered in the .docx for this item (SKILL.md: 'do NOT pick an authoritative-sounding answer ... Hand it back; do not bury it in fluent prose').

contested.description: Genuinely unsettled or out-of-scope positions — the delivery summary's Contested/Open-items block. Every entry here is a gap in the core-artefact projection.

applicable.description: Whether the notice addresses children's data at all (EU_COMMON.md 'Children's Data' step 1/2).

effective_age_applied.description: The single age threshold actually applied notice-wide, used only when localizes_users is false (EU_COMMON.md 'Multi-jurisdiction rule' fallback).

jurisdiction_thresholds_used.description: Per-market age threshold actually applied, used when localizes_users is true.

indicators_flagged.description: Count of WP248 rev.01 criteria flagged in SKILL.md Group G, for this run.

routed_to_dpia_sentinel.description: Whether the user was told to run dpia-sentinel per SKILL.md:230 (advertised handoff).

validation.description: Optional, embedded by the skill for human readability. --emit-core-artefact ignores this block and rebuilds from the live validation result, never from here.
